---
title: "QCDrift - Quality Control Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    theme: flatly
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    self_contained: true
params:
  meta: NULL
  verdict: NULL
  figs: NULL
  review: NULL
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Verdict

```{r, results='asis'}
v <- params$verdict
if (!is.null(v)) {
  cat("**", v$title, "**\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(v$headline, "\n\n")
  if (nzchar(v$detail)) cat(v$detail, "\n\n")
  cat("*CV limit used: ", v$thr, "%.*\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Run summary

```{r}
knitr::kable(params$meta, col.names = c("Item", "Value"))
```

## Features to review

```{r, results='asis'}
if (is.null(params$review) || nrow(params$review) == 0) {
  cat("No features were above the CV limit after correction.\n")
} else {
  cat("Top ", nrow(params$review), " features above the limit after correction ",
      "(the full list is in the exported workbook).\n\n", sep = "")
  print(knitr::kable(params$review, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE))
}
```

## Diagnostic figures

**How to read them:** tight clustering of QC samples in the corrected PCA,
CV values below the limit, consistent violin medians after normalization, and
the disappearance of vertical colour stripes in the heatmap all indicate that
instrumental drift was successfully removed.

```{r, results='asis'}
for (nm in names(params$figs)) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(sprintf("![](%s)\n\n", params$figs[[nm]]))
}
```
